name: wenyu-portfolio
description: Personal portfolio site. Source is JSX compiled to a single bundle by esbuild (no in-browser Babel). Run `npm run build` after editing *.jsx / content.js, then commit assets/app.bundle.js.

scripts.test: node scripts/verify-site.mjs && node scripts/check-copy.mjs --strict --require-pdfs && node scripts/test-navigator.mjs && npm run test:webmcp && npm run test:worker
scripts.deploy:worker: npm run check:nvidia-model && wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.jsonc
